title: MC-NDI 2
description: Adds NDI video output support to Minecraft
body:
Adds NDI video output support to Minecraft.
[NDI](https://ndi.tv/) is a royalty-free standard enabling IP video over Ethernet.

Outputs the main screen as an NDI source named "MC - Username" by default. You can also add multiple cameras with individual NDI outputs.

## Features

- **NDI Settings Screen** - Press N to configure resolution and FPS
- **Custom Resolution Output** - Output at different resolutions than your game window
- **Multiple Camera Support** - Add cameras with their own NDI outputs
- **Camera Management** - Teleport to cameras, move cameras to your position

## Controls

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| R | Place a camera at your current position |
| N | Open NDI settings |

## Dependencies

- [NDI Runtime](https://ndi.tv/) (NDI Tools or NDI SDK)
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)

## Under the Hood

Uses the [Devolay library by WalkerKnapp](https://github.com/WalkerKnapp/devolay) (Apache-2.0 license).
